sn_aia_tool.description: Read-only lookup of one PTAG engagement request for triage: per-axis Desirability/Viability/Feasibility signal rollup (confirmed vs not confirmed at intake), narrative heads with character counts, and the SYSTEM-STAMPED assessment (score, band label, scoring model version) as citable facts. Input: request_sys_id.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"request_sys_id","description":"sys_id of the engagement request record (from the objective text)","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: PTAG - Get triage signals
